groups.purpose: Population-derived offered demand at fixed smallest tested resource tier; failure retained.
Highest tested passing offered rate and next failing rate per language; fixed grid, no interpolated maximum.
Cold/churning working-set diagnosis with full heavy-Pod admission attempted; rate is a diagnostic stress, not inferred from these small populations.

dedicated_checks.authorization: Run direct independent rights/result oracle, explicit heavy-quantile admission, actual HTTP positive/negative authentication and post-mutation/revocation checks before eligible timing. Admission rejection is a capacity finding, not an oracle mismatch.
dedicated_checks.policy_churn: Separate deterministic grant/revoke lane with confirmed changes and post-acknowledgement query checks; do not treat rare or zero sampled policy operations as successful churn evidence.
dedicated_checks.network: An isolated network namespace is required for measured regional/mobile journey latency; no modification of SSH interface. Missing implementation yields unmeasured status, never an added-percentile estimate.
dedicated_checks.indexed_comparison: Bounded identical-history raw and compressed native Graph persistence comparison; existing open-time validation retained. Record actual file count/allocated storage/open/materialization/query times, and exact result equality. This is a component test and does not establish indexed million-Pod storage.

stop_rules.invalid_correctness: Stop and quarantine affected source/configuration; retain failures.
stop_rules.resource: Record OOM, maximum Pod admission, low disk or client saturation explicitly. Never reduce histories or remove heavy users to obtain a pass.
stop_rules.full_history_large_population: Do not allocate a million-history corpus solely to repeat failure at smaller sizes: require a full-history configuration to pass cold/admission and mixed-load criteria first. Report unreached scales as unmeasured.
stop_rules.grid: Complete all five paired repetitions of a cell; skip a larger offered rate after both models fail the previous rate in every replicate, recording the skipped cell and trigger. Do not apply this skip to physical compact population generation.
stop_rules.memory_search: Stop a hot-set memory ladder after first tier passes both languages in all paired replicates; retain smaller failed tiers.

artifact_rules.source: Commit this campaign and source before launch; record exact commit, source/config hashes and binary hash.
artifact_rules.raw: Losslessly zstd-compress per-request records and Pod inventories after close; include compressed hashes in final manifest.
artifact_rules.persistence: Every counted Pod is generated and written before timing. Preserve pack/index hashes, total records/quads/source/compressed bytes and all per-Pod inventories.
artifact_rules.measurement_boundary: Per-server cgroup including charged page cache; report host and client resources separately. Flush OS cache before first cold run, record warmup and all cache settings.
artifact_rules.cost: Conservative preflight and actual runtime estimates for build, generation, measurement and teardown; not invoice charges.
